metadata.title: Plakio — Simple parking lot software
metadata.description: Manage your parking lot from your phone. Check-in, check-out, digital tickets and automatic billing. 30-day free trial.

hero.title: The simplest software to <highlight>manage your parking lot</highlight>
hero.description: Check-in and check-out from your phone, digital tickets and automatic billing. No complications.
hero.footnote: Available for Android and iOS · Free 30-day trial

features.title: Everything you need
features.description: Designed for parking lots of any size. Simple to use, powerful for your business.

items.title: Check-in from your phone
items.description: Register vehicle entry in seconds. Just enter the license plate and you're done.

items.title: Automatic digital ticket
items.description: Each vehicle receives a unique code. No paper, no printers.

items.title: Automatic billing
items.description: Calculate the amount to pay based on time and the rate you define.

items.title: Real-time dashboard
items.description: See how many vehicles are inside, daily revenue and historical stats.

items.title: Safe and reliable
items.description: Encrypted data backed up in the cloud. Your information always available.

items.title: Monthly plans for your customers
items.description: Register recurring customers and charge their monthly fees easily.

cta.title: Get started in 3 steps
cta.description: Download the app, set up your parking lot and start charging.
steps: Download the Plakio app on your phone
Create your account with your parking lot name
Set your rate and start operating
